course.title: Unit 4 My Favourite Subject【例句】
course.description: SECTION B What can you learn from different subjects?

sentences.content: I study maths, music, French, history, English, IT, science, and have gym.
sentences.english: I study maths , music , French , history , English , IT , science , and have gym
sentences.chinese: 我学习数学、音乐、法语、历史、英语、信息技术、科学，还有体育课。

sentences.content: My favourite subject is music because the class is fun and we learn a lot of new songs.
sentences.english: My favourite subject is music because the class is fun and we learn a lot of new songs
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的科目是音乐课，因为课堂很有趣，而且我们能学到很多新歌。
我的音乐老师非常出色。

sentences.content: He lets us play all kinds of interesting instruments.
sentences.english: He lets us play all kinds of interesting instruments
sentences.chinese: 他让我们演奏各种有趣的乐器。

wordDetails.definition: let（第三人称单数现在时）: 让

sentences.content: I want to be a singer in the future.
sentences.english: I want to be a singer in the future
sentences.chinese: 我将来想成为一名歌手。

sentences.content: What's your favourite class and why?
sentences.english: What's your favourite class and why ?
sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的课程是什么？为什么？

sentences.content: This term, I have subjects like Chinese, history, maths, English, PE, and IT.
sentences.english: This term , I have subjects like Chinese , history , maths , English , PE , and IT
sentences.chinese: 这学期，我有语文、历史、数学、英语、体育和信息技术这些科目。

sentences.content: I like all the subjects, but my favourite is maths.
sentences.english: I like all the subjects , but my favourite is maths
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢所有的科目，但最喜欢的是数学。

sentences.content: I like it because I'm good with numbers.
sentences.english: I like it because I'm good with numbers
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢它，因为我擅长数字。

sentences.content: We learn how to work out maths problems in class.
sentences.english: We learn how to work out maths problems in class
sentences.chinese: 我们在课堂上学习如何解数学题。

sentences.content: It feels like magic and is really fun.
sentences.english: It feels like magic and is really fun
sentences.chinese: 这感觉就像魔法一样，非常有趣。

wordDetails.definition: feel（第三人称单数）: 感觉

sentences.content: Maths is very useful in our life.
sentences.english: Maths is very useful in our life
sentences.chinese: 数学在我们的生活中非常有用。

sentences.content: I want to be a scientist in the future.
sentences.english: I want to be a scientist in the future
sentences.chinese: 我将来想成为一名科学家。
